decision: Develop a proof-carrying incremental history contract before another empirical representation sweep. Continue the existing rolling solver as the practical estimator baseline.

gates.name: Define exact meaning and useful error
must_resolve: Aging transition/rate uncertainty, including RC state transfer
Physical query error allocation versus existing SOC/Q point targets
Maximum admitted update rate and weak-excitation policy

gates.name: Prove the incremental rolling token
gates.deliverable: One versioned token/operator with source interval, boundary state relation, prior ownership, noise model and actual exposure
acceptance: Repeated queries add no evidence
Overlapping windows cannot be counted twice
Chronological composition matches uncompressed replay
Pure repetitions aggregate exactly in the admitted base family

gates.name: Build an exact closed aging reference
gates.deliverable: Small scalar/vector linear-Gaussian or exact bounded-set transition reference with chronological elimination; hypotheses clearly narrower than full battery
acceptance: Forward message equals batch elimination
Old information weakens only through explicit admitted aging uncertainty
Unexcited directions remain unresolved
Arithmetic and ownership limits are explicit

gates.name: Derive the battery gallery closure
gates.deliverable: Physical stimulus/response dictionary and dependence graph showing which mixed functions close under composition and aging
acceptance: Preserve chronology and carried-state/health correlations
Separate exact sufficient coefficients from approximate remainders
Prove finite size or declare growth/unresolved status
Bind coefficients to SOC,Q and future-response queries

gates.name: Prove finite-horizon error and resources
gates.deliverable: Certified local defect ledger, actual stability bounds, count/range proofs and complete SRAM/work accounting
acceptance: Apply L9 over every admitted prefix through ten years
No unproved contraction or reset of spent error budget
Conservative fallback on out-of-domain stimulus or aging
Nominal35Hz is not used as an unstated maximum event rate

gates.name: Falsify and qualify the composed system
gates.deliverable: Fresh-source finite causal trajectories plus adversarial repetitive/weak-stimulus/aging tests, using the proof obligations as test oracles
acceptance: Separate history duration, future horizon, age and compaction count
Compare rolling baseline and exact small reference
Retain source uncertainty and all failures
Only then expand to physical ten-year envelopes and MCU qualification

no_more_unstructured_sweeps: A new approximation family must identify the lemma it preserves, the defect it bounds and the lifetime budget it consumes before battery fitting.
scope_of_current_completion: Written foundation and finite mathematical witnesses, not P1–P5 implementation or ten-year qualification.
